system.notes: Cell 4 of the registered design (paper §10.1 Table 11). The act-thick, repair-thick case, and the positive control on which the gating rule stands: if Stratum D were empty here, either the detector is invalid or the rule is false.

authority.filler: the rules themselves, promulgated under the Rules Enabling Act and adopted by the Supreme Court

evidence.note: The rules state their own scope and the courts to which they apply.
Districts may adopt local rules, but only consistent with these rules; the constraint is stated internally.

authority.note: The enabling statute is external, but the operative authority to fix procedural criteria is exercised within the instrument.

criteria.filler: the substantive standards of each rule

evidence.note: States what a pleading must contain.
States the four prerequisites for class treatment.
States the standard for summary judgment.

assessor.filler: the district judge, magistrate judge, and clerk

evidence.note: Assigns entry of default to the clerk specifically.
Assigns the certification determination to the court.

facts.filler: the record, affidavits, and discovery material

evidence.note: Failure to defend shown by affidavit or otherwise.
Specifies the materials on which a factual position may rest.

act.filler: judgment, order, entry of default, certification

evidence.note: Entry of judgment is specified and performed within the system.
Certification is by order of the court.
Specifies what a judgment is and what relief it may include.
Enforcement of a money judgment, though the procedure defers to state law.

effects.note: Partly outward-facing: Rules 64 and 69 route enforcement through state procedure. Recorded as internal because the effect is conferred by the judgment the system itself enters.

remedy.filler: new trial, relief from judgment, setting aside default

evidence.note: New trial, with its own deadline.
Relief from a final judgment, with grounds and timing specified internally.
Setting aside an entry of default.

remedy.note: Appellate review lies outside this instrument, but the system provides internal repair pathways of its own, which is what repair-thick requires.

provenance: Assigned by inspection of the governing text. Chain extraction has no established reliability (paper §13); this assignment has not been checked against a second annotator.
